_recorded: NOT recorded from the Cloudflare API: no Cloudflare API token was available to the builder (2026-11-12). Written in the shapes of the cloudflare SDK 7.3.0's types (r2.buckets.get, domains.custom.list, domains.managed.list, cors.get, lifecycle.get, rulesets.phases.get, accounts.tokens.list). What is real: the bucket name ponzu-dev (dev's R2_BUCKET), the custom domain assets-dev.ponzu.cloud, and the CORS rule, read from the public host's own answers (an OPTIONS preflight answered origin *, methods GET, HEAD, PUT, any requested header, max age 86400; a GET exposed ETag). What is assumed: the custom domain's status, r2.dev being off, the lifecycle being Cloudflare's documented default for a new bucket (abort incomplete uploads after 7 days, so founder step B6 is still to come), no transform rule on assets-dev.ponzu.cloud (its responses carry no CSP header), and one account token scoped to ponzu-dev. The account id in resource keys is a placeholder. The orchestrator's first run with a read-only token replaces this with what dev answers.
